name: geo-nuts-administrative-boundaries
title: European NUTS boundaries as GeoJSON at 1:60m
description: Boundaries of the European NUTS regions (levels 1, 2 and 3, edition 2024, scale 1:60 million, EPSG:4326) as GeoJSON, rebuilt from the Eurostat GISCO files.

sources.name: GISCO (the Geographical Information System at the COmmission)
sources.title: GISCO (the Geographical Information System at the COmmission)

licenses.name: ODC-PDDL-1.0
licenses.title: Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License v1.0

fields.name: NUTS_ID
fields.description: NUTS code of the region, for example DE212.

fields.name: LEVL_CODE
fields.description: NUTS level: 1, 2 or 3.

fields.name: CNTR_CODE
fields.description: Two-letter country code used by Eurostat, for example DE or EL.

fields.name: NAME_LATN
fields.description: Region name in Latin script.

fields.name: NUTS_NAME
fields.description: Region name in the national language and script (for example Greek or Cyrillic).

fields.name: MOUNT_TYPE
fields.description: Mountain typology code from GISCO. Empty (null) where GISCO gives none.

fields.name: URBN_TYPE
fields.description: Urban-rural typology code from GISCO. Empty (null) where GISCO gives none.

fields.name: COAST_TYPE
fields.description: Coastal typology code from GISCO. Empty (null) where GISCO gives none.

fields.name: NAME_ENGL
fields.description: Country name in English.

fields.name: NAME_FREN
fields.description: Country name in French. Empty (null) on a few features.

fields.name: ISO3_CODE
fields.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 country code.

fields.name: SVRG_UN
fields.description: Sovereignty status of the country, for example UN Member State.

fields.name: CAPT
fields.description: Capital of the country. Empty (null) on a few features.

fields.name: EU_STAT
fields.description: T if the country is an EU member state, otherwise F.

fields.name: EFTA_STAT
fields.description: T if the country is an EFTA member, otherwise F.

fields.name: CC_STAT
fields.description: T if the country is an EU candidate country, otherwise F.

fields.name: NAME_GERM
fields.description: Country name in German. Empty (null) on a few features.
